complaint: Someone used my debit card without my permission at a gas station and $250 was deducted.
admin_notes: Card blocked immediately. Dispatched to Fraud & Risk Prevention for transaction chargeback recovery.

complaint: My credit card was stolen from my wallet yesterday and I need to freeze it immediately to prevent fraud.
admin_notes: Card frozen. Emergency replacement card requested via express delivery.

complaint: I requested a replacement contactless card 12 days ago but I still have not received it in the mail.
admin_notes: Ticket queued. Postal dispatch tracking number requested from Card Fulfillment team.

complaint: I noticed an unknown recurring monthly account maintenance fee of $25 on my checking account statement.
admin_notes: Waived the $25 maintenance fee and credited back to account. Upgraded account tier to zero-fee student tier.

complaint: I tried to transfer money to another account via SEPA but the transfer is stuck in pending status since yesterday.
admin_notes: Pending clearing batch check with European Central Clearing House.

complaint: An unauthorized ATM cash withdrawal of $400 appeared on my account history while I was out of town.
admin_notes: Security video requested from ATM operator. Provisional $400 credit issued.

complaint: I cannot log in to my mobile banking app because I forgot my passcode and verification SMS is not arriving.
admin_notes: Identity verified via telephone KYC. Passcode reset link sent securely to customer's verified email.

complaint: Why was I charged an international transaction exchange fee when purchasing online from a local merchant?
admin_notes: Merchant processor is registered in the UK. Explained international interchange fee regulations.

complaint: My virtual card was declined when trying to pay for a software subscription online.
admin_notes: 3D Secure authentication failure investigated. Recommended refreshing disposable virtual card.

complaint: I deposited a paycheck of $1,200 at the branch ATM two days ago but my account balance has not updated.
admin_notes: Cheque clearance underway. Funds expected to settle by end of business day.

complaint: I need to dispute a double charge of $89.99 for groceries at supermarket yesterday.
admin_notes: Merchant reconciliation request submitted for the duplicate debit.

complaint: Can you explain the age limit and identity documentation required to open a joint savings account?
admin_notes: Guidelines and digital KYC requirements emailed to customer.

complaint: My transfer to a beneficiary was rejected without any explanation and funds were not credited back.
admin_notes: Beneficiary IBAN format validation issue detected. Reverse transfer initiated.

complaint: I received an alert that my online banking password was changed from an unrecognized IP address in another country.
admin_notes: CRITICAL ESCALATION: User session invalidated, web banking locked pending two-factor re-verification.

complaint: I was promised a refund from an airline 3 weeks ago but it is not showing up in my pending transactions.
admin_notes: Merchant acquirer initiated refund today. Credit settled in user account.

complaint: My debit card was swallowed by the ATM machine and no cash was dispensed.
admin_notes: Ticket registered in automated queue. Assigned to specialized team for initial triage.
